commands.name: Hermes Ops Cockpit
commands.description: iMac native cmux workspace for MBP Hermes runtime monitoring via SSH/tmux plus local vault/docs surfaces.
commands.command: ssh mbp-runtime 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux attach -t mission-hermes || tmux new -s mission-hermes'

commands.name: OpenClaw Ops Cockpit
commands.description: iMac native cmux workspace for MBP OpenClaw runtime monitoring via SSH/tmux plus local project/browser surfaces.
commands.command: ssh mbp-runtime 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux attach -t mission-openclaw || tmux new -s mission-openclaw'

commands.name: Code Workbench
commands.description: Attach the rich MBP cockpit-workbench tmux deck: Neovim, browser surface, agents, GitHub, Obsidian, Discord, scratch panes, and keystroke rails.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; CMUX_SESSION=cockpit-workbench CMUX_TITLE="Cockpit Workbench" /Users/openclaw/.local/bin/cockpit-workbench --no-attach --project=/Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-cli-cockpit >/dev/null && tmux attach -d -t cockpit-workbench'

commands.name: Agent Deck
commands.description: Jump to the rich cockpit-workbench agents window with live inventory, agent slots, command scratch panes, and shortcuts.
commands.command: ssh -t mbp-runtime 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; tmux has-session -t cockpit-workbench 2>/dev/null || CMUX_SESSION=cockpit-workbench CMUX_TITLE="Cockpit Workbench" /Users/openclaw/.local/bin/cockpit-workbench --no-attach --project=/Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-cli-cockpit >/dev/null; tmux select-window -t cockpit-workbench:agents; tmux attach -d -t cockpit-workbench'

commands.name: Obsidian Vault
commands.description: Open canonical Hermes workspace/vault path from a native cmux terminal surface.
commands.command: cd "$HOME/.hermes/workspace" && pwd && printf 'Vault root ready. Open Finder/file panel/browser/Obsidian surface from cmux.\n'
